description: This file is a Java test configuration class that defines Spring Beans for testing purposes within the Fineract loan starter module. It mocks certain repositories and services and creates bean instances for a COB business step service, sampling service factory, and loan account domain service.

classes.name: TestDefaultConfiguration
classes.description: A Spring configuration class that defines bean methods for testing purposes within the Fineract loan module.

methods.name: batchBusinessStepRepository
methods.description: Creates a mock instance of BatchBusinessStepRepository for testing.

methods.name: businessEventNotifierService
methods.description: Creates a mock instance of BusinessEventNotifierService for testing.

methods.name: cobBusinessStepService
methods.description: Defines a bean for COBBusinessStepService by instantiating COBBusinessStepServiceImpl with required dependencies.

methods.name: samplingServiceFactory
methods.description: Creates an instance of SamplingServiceFactory using the provided SamplingConfiguration.

methods.name: loanAccountDomainService
methods.description: Creates a mock instance of LoanAccountDomainService for testing.
